companies.name: ベライゾン・コミュニケーションズ

relations.text: 自社の無線サービスはベライゾンの無線ネットワークで提供している
relations.text_en: Comcast's domestic wireless services run over Verizon's wireless network

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Our domestic wireless services are offered over Verizon’s wireless network and our existing network of secure residential, outdoor and business Wi-Fi hotspots, and are offered initially only as part of our bundled service offerings to customers that subscribe to our qualifying broadband services.

relations.text: 法人向けの無線サービスで、2026年からTモバイルの網も使う予定だ
relations.text_en: Comcast plans to also use T-Mobile's wireless network for business customers beginning in 2026

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Our domestic wireless services are offered to business customers over Verizon’s wireless network and beginning in 2026, we will also use T-Mobile’s wireless network.

relations.text: 2023年に一部の周波数免許をTモバイルへ売却する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Comcast agreed in 2023 to sell certain spectrum licenses to T-Mobile

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In 2023, we entered into an agreement with T-Mobile to sell certain of our spectrum licenses.

companies.name: パラマウント・スカイダンス

relations.text: 映画・テレビ番組の主要なライセンス契約の相手先に含まれる
relations.text_en: Paramount is among the parties to the most significant content licensing agreements

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: the most significant agreements for the licensing of film and television entertainment content include rights with Paramount, Warner Bros. and our Studios segment, certain of which are exclusive rights.

companies.name: ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー

relations.text: 映画・テレビ番組の主要なライセンス契約の相手先に含まれる
relations.text_en: Warner Bros. is among the parties to the most significant content licensing agreements

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: the most significant agreements for the licensing of film and television entertainment content include rights with Paramount, Warner Bros. and our Studios segment, certain of which are exclusive rights.

companies.name: チャーター・コミュニケーションズ

relations.text: ストリーミング基盤Xumoの合弁会社をチャーターと運営している
relations.text_en: Comcast runs the Xumo streaming platform joint venture with Charter

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Xumo, our consolidated streaming platform joint venture with Charter Communications.

relations.text: ドイツのSky事業をRTLグループへ売却する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Comcast agreed to sell its Sky operations in Germany to RTL Group

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: In 2025, we entered into an agreement with RTL Group to sell our Sky operations in Germany, subject to various conditions and approvals, and we expect the sale to be completed in 2026.

relations.text: アタイロスの唯一の外部投資家である
relations.text_en: Comcast is the only third-party investor in Atairos

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We are the only third-party investor in Atairos.

companies.name: エーティーアンドティー

relations.text: 固定無線などでブロードバンドを提供する無線事業者に含まれる
relations.text_en: AT&T is among wireless companies offering internet services that compete with Comcast broadband

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Various wireless companies, such as AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon, offer internet services using a variety of wireless technologies, including 5G fixed wireless networks and 4G and 5G wireless broadband services.

companies.name: ウォルト・ディズニー

relations.text: 動画サービスでの競合先にディズニー+が含まれる
relations.text_en: Disney+ is among the video services Comcast competes with

source.label: コムキャスト 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: subscription-based services, such as Disney+ and Netflix, that offer online services that enable internet streaming and downloading of movies, television shows and other video programming

relations.text: 動画サービスでの競合先にネットフリックスが含まれる
relations.text_en: Netflix is among the video services Comcast competes with

source.quote: subscription-based services, such as Disney+ and Netflix, that offer online services that enable internet streaming and downloading of movies, television shows and other video programming
